title: ak profiles --json (profiles-v1)
description: Every account the kit knows, portable to another host: names and kinds only. Never contains a secret value, an account identity or an absolute path. Another host recreates the set with `ak profiles add <cli> @<name>` and logs each one in. Consumers check `schema` and `interface` first; additional keys may appear in later minor versions.

profiles.description: Ordered: CLI order of providers.toml, then @default, then profile names.

path_relative.description: <cli>/<name> under the profiles root (AGENTKIT_PROFILES_DIR); null for @default, which is the CLI's own home.

default.description: Since 0.5.2, present only on the account a bare `ak <cli>` launches by AGENTKIT_DEFAULT_PROFILE_<CLI> (none for `pick`).

login.description: How the account is logged in, by presence only; unknown when the CLI keeps no detectable login.

key_names_set.description: Names (never values) of the provider keys and login token this account reads that are set.
